title: Palmer Museum of History & Art

services.name: ― Exhibits
services.desc: The Palmer Museum features permanent exhibits showcasing the story of the Palmer area. Starting with the region’s origins as a meeting place between Ahtna and Dena’ina lands, follow the development of the region through the fur trade, the railroad, gold mining, and the 1935 Matanuska Colony Project. The museum also features outdoor displays of agricultural equipment, and a rotating lineup of temporary displays showcasing Palmer’s art, history, and culture. Our permanent exhibits at the Palmer Museum showcase the rich history of Palmer. Indoors, or outdoors, we strive to fulfill the promise of educating our community and those who visit.
